title: First working day and derived insurance start date
goal: Have the employee confirm their first working day and derive the pension insurance start date from it, so the employee is never asked for a date they cannot know.
context: The first working day is the most important item because it often changes. HR wants the employee to confirm it (F-TR-014, F-TR-015, F-TR-019). The pension fund needs an insurance start date that is always the 1st of a month (F-SC-008, F-SC-009, F-SC-019). That date follows from the first working day: on the 1st of a month insurance starts that day, otherwise on the 1st of the following month (F-TR-016 to F-TR-018). Following G-08, Lonio asks for the primary fact (the first working day) and derives the start date from the latest confirmed value.

stories.title: Employee confirms their first working day
stories.i_want: every new employee to confirm their first working day themselves during onboarding
stories.so_that: I always work with the employee's current start date, even when it has moved, and do not have to chase it manually
stories.priority_reason: HR calls the first working day 'the number one thing'; it changes often and a missed change already caused a wrong pension registration that took weeks to fix (F-TR-014, F-TR-015, F-TR-019).

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is going through onboarding, whatever their other answers
acceptance_criteria.then: they are asked to confirm their first working day at Muster AG as a date (DD.MM.YYYY), and they cannot complete onboarding while it is empty

acceptance_criteria.title: The latest confirmed first working day is the one that counts
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has confirmed a first working day and the date later moves (e.g. they leave their old employer a week earlier)
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee confirms the new first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the newly confirmed date replaces the earlier one for HR and the pension fund, and everything derived from it (the insurance start date) follows the new date

acceptance_criteria.title: Who receives the first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has confirmed their first working day
acceptance_criteria.when: the onboarding data is used by the receiving parties
acceptance_criteria.then: HR receives the confirmed first working day, and it is the basis for the pension fund's insurance start date

stories.title: Insurance start date is derived from the first working day
stories.i_want: to receive an insurance start date that is always the 1st of a month and correctly follows the employee's latest confirmed first working day
stories.so_that: the employee is insured from the right date without the employee being asked for a date they cannot know
stories.priority_reason: The insurance start date is a required field in the fund's registration; a wrong date (Julia's case) led to an unfriendly letter from the fund and weeks of correction (F-SC-008, F-TR-019).

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee is never asked for the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is going through onboarding
acceptance_criteria.then: they are not asked for an insurance start date; it is derived from their confirmed first working day

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day on the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.given: the confirmed first working day is the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: insurance starts on the first working day itself

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day on any other day
acceptance_criteria.given: the confirmed first working day is not the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: insurance starts on the 1st of the following month, also across a year end

examples.name: Start in December rolls into the next year

acceptance_criteria.title: Insurance start date follows a moved first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee first confirmed 01.03.2026 as first working day and later confirms 15.03.2026 instead
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date is derived
acceptance_criteria.then: it is derived from the latest confirmed date only (01.04.2026), never from the earlier one, and it is always the 1st of a month as the pension fund requires
